summary: 52 items were scored for price elasticity: 21 are inelastic (|e| < 1) and 10 are A/B test candidates this cycle.
4 of 6 active or recent campaigns clear ROI 1.0; the Weekend Family Deal Push is increment-negative and queued for retirement.
3 items are promo traps — Zinger Burger depends on discounts for 61% of volume while losing 18% profit per promo order.
insight.whyItMatters: Pricing moves and promotion spend draw on the same margin pool: raising inelastic items funds retirement of negative-ROI discounts, and the trap list shows exactly where discount dependency has become structural.
